admissions_overview.summary: In Namibia you apply directly to each institution, usually between May and September of the year before you start (UNAM's 2027 applications ran from 22 May to 30 September 2026). Admission uses your NSSCO and NSSCAS results across five subjects. For a UNAM degree you need two NSSCAS subjects averaging D or better plus three NSSCO subjects at C or better, or three NSSCAS subjects averaging D or better plus two NSSCO subjects at D or better, with English at least C at NSSCO; many diplomas accept five NSSCO subjects. Study loans and grants come from the Namibia Students Financial Assistance Fund (NSFAF).
admissions_overview.notes: UNAM programme names are from its 2027 career guidance leaflets and NUST names from its undergraduate programmes page. IUM publishes its degrees without naming the faculty, so the grouping by faculty here is Ace's own. Requirements change every year, so check each institution before applying.
